title: skills poke the recompile gate of their own checkout
intention: /intent, /sorted and /design poke the recompile gate of the cairn checkout they are run from, so a worktree's poke writes that worktree's commons lab and never the house one.
why: Measured 2026-11-16: skills/intent/SKILL.md:34, skills/sorted/SKILL.md:273 and skills/design/SKILL.md:26 name $HOME/dev/src/cairn/cairn/tools/intentions_model_compiler/recompile_gate.sh, the house copy, and the gate derives its repo from its own path. So a /sorted fired from the wt-dgt worktree rewrote the house commons' intentions-congruency-lab/ from the house cairn's charters. That dirt landed as 5bb9c1c6 (found while measuring 6fb272ba3d64).
traces_to: RULE 1 and Law 6: a worktree's work writes only its own roots; the house commons is written by whoever lands, not by a skill fired elsewhere.
how: In each of the three SKILL.md files, replace $HOME/dev/src/cairn/cairn/tools/intentions_model_compiler/recompile_gate.sh with "$(git rev-parse --show-toplevel)"/cairn/tools/intentions_model_compiler/recompile_gate.sh (quotes included). Each skill gets one new proof, which reads its own SKILL.md and takes every gate command it names: a code-block line or a backtick span ending in recompile_gate.sh. It then builds a scratch checkout (git init) holding an executable stub gate that prints OWN, and a scratch HOME holding an executable decoy at dev/src/cairn/cairn/tools/intentions_model_compiler/recompile_gate.sh that prints HOUSE. It runs each command with bash -c, cwd at the checkout and HOME at the scratch home, and asserts the output is OWN.
